titleEn: Append K Integers With Minimal Sum
title: 向数组中追加 K 个整数
summary: 向数组追加 k 个互不相同且原数组中不存在的正整数，使追加数字之和最小。
insight: 排序去重后从一开始填空档。遇到已有值 value 时，先取 current 到 value-1 中最多 k 个最小数；最后若仍不足，取连续尾段。用等差数列 O(1) 求和。
pitfalls: 原数组重复值只阻塞一次
追加数字必须彼此不同

solutions.title: 排序空档与等差和
solutions.idea: 按正整数顺序批量选取未出现的最小值。
steps: 跳过重复或小于 current 的 value；take=min(remaining,value-current)，累加 current..current+take-1
令 current=value+1；扫描结束后补 remaining 个连续数

code.java: class Solution { private long range(long start,long count){return count*(2*start+count-1)/2;}public long minimalKSum(int[] nums,int k){Arrays.sort(nums);long current=1,answer=0,remaining=k;for(int value:nums){if(value<current)continue;long take=Math.min(remaining,value-current);answer+=range(current,take);remaining-=take;if(remaining==0)return answer;current=(long)value+1;}return answer+range(current,remaining);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun range(start:Long,count:Long)=count*(2*start+count-1)/2;fun minimalKSum(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Long{nums.sort();var current=1L;var answer=0L;var remaining=k.toLong();for(value in nums){if(value<current)continue;val take=minOf(remaining,value-current);answer+=range(current,take);remaining-=take;if(remaining==0L)return answer;current=value.toLong()+1};return answer+range(current,remaining)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long range(long long start,long long count){return count*(2*start+count-1)/2;}public:long long minimalKSum(vector<int>& nums,int k){sort(nums.begin(),nums.end());long long current=1,answer=0,remaining=k;for(int value:nums){if(value<current)continue;long long take=min(remaining,(long long)value-current);answer+=range(current,take);remaining-=take;if(!remaining)return answer;current=(long long)value+1;}return answer+range(current,remaining);} };
